old_caption: The video captures a serene sunset over a cityscape, with the sky transitioning through a vibrant palette of colors. The horizon is dominated by hues of deep purple and pink, gradually blending into warmer tones of orange and yellow near the sun's position on the right side of the frame. Wispy clouds are scattered across the sky, adding texture to the scene. Below, the silhouette of the city is visible, with buildings and rooftops forming a dark outline against the colorful backdrop. The distant hills are also silhouetted, enhancing the depth of the landscape. The overall atmosphere is tranquil, with no significant movement or action occurring, allowing viewers to fully absorb the beauty of the natural and urban elements together.

caption: The video captures a wide, eye-level sunset view over a densely built city, with a dark silhouetted mountain ridge across the lower frame and a thin antenna pole rising left of center. Soft purple and pink cloud cover fills the sky, while a bright yellow-orange band glows low on the horizon toward the right, interrupted by a small dark cloud notch. The camera holds still, so the town rooftops remain fixed and all visible motion stays in the sky. The puffy clouds at the upper-left and the darker oval cloud at left-center drift and reshape very slowly. The glowing horizon band keeps its saturation as warmth spreads faintly upward, and a few tiny point lights flicker in the foreground. The excerpt shows a continuous, gentle evolution of cloud motion and light rather than any discrete event.
